title: knowledge-atoms base atom
description: Base schema every atom in the knowledge-atoms catalog satisfies. Discriminated by `type`; one of: entity-type, relationship-type, provenance-atom, fact-type, confidence-primitive. Atoms that assert facts (relationship-type instances, fact-type instances) carry a non-empty `provenance` array and a `confidence` block per the v0.1 acceptance criterion for issue #4.

schema.description: Absolute URI of the per-type schema this atom validates against.

id.description: URL-safe slug; unique within the atom's type.

provenance.description: Where this atom's claim originates. Each entry references a provenance-atom by knowledge-atoms URI. Required on fact-type and on relationship instances when used to assert a concrete fact; optional on schema-like atoms (entity-type, relationship-type definitions).

confidence.description: Calibrated confidence in this atom's claim. Required on fact-type instances and on contradicting relationship assertions. See atoms/confidence-primitive/* for the calibration primitives this block references.

value.description: Probability in [0,1]. 0 = certainly false, 1 = certainly true.
